record.t: Filed a lawsuit against a company over allegations of unlawful and deceptive practices toward consumers seeking foreclosure assistance, which ended in a Final Consent Judgement approved by a Fulton County Superior Court Judge on Nov. 6, 2026.

record.t: Secured a court order terminating all contracts with MV Realty in August 2025.
record.q: In August 2025, Carr secured a court order terminating all contracts with MV Realty , a Florida-based brokerage firm that was accused of tricking Georgia homeowners into signing 40-year listing agreements.

record.t: Was re-elected as Georgia's Attorney General in November 2022, after first being appointed to the role in 2016 by Governor Nathan Deal.
record.q: Chris Carr was re-elected as Georgia's Attorney General in November 2022. Then-Governor Nathan Deal first appointed him to the role in 2016.

record.t: Created the Gang Prosecution Unit in July 2022.
record.q: Created in July 2022, Carr’s Gang Prosecution Unit has since partnered with the Athens-Clarke County Police Department (ACCPD), the Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI), and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to obtain more than 20 convictions in Athens alone

record.t: Created the Human Trafficking Prosecution Unit in 2019.
record.q: In 2019, he created Georgia’s first-ever Human Trafficking Prosecution Unit, which rescued and assisted 352 victims just last year.

record.t: Was appointed Attorney General by Governor Nathan Deal to fill the vacancy created by Sam Olens' departure, and was sworn into office on November 1, 2016.
record.q: Governor Nathan Deal appointed Carr as Attorney General to fill a vacancy created by the departure of former Attorney General Sam Olens to become president of Kennesaw State University.

record.t: Has served as Georgia's Attorney General since 2016.
record.q: Chris Carr has served as Georgia’s Attorney General since 2016 with a mission of protecting the lives, livelihoods and liberties of all Georgians.

record.t: Served as Commissioner of the Georgia Department of Economic Development under Governor Nathan Deal from November 2013 to November 2016.
record.q: Carr previously served as Commissioner of the Georgia Department of Economic Development (GDEcD) under Governor Deal from November 2013 to November 2016.

record.t: Announced a $17.1 billion multistate settlement with Meta Platforms, Inc.
record.q: Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr today announced a landmark $17.1 billion multistate settlement with Meta Platforms, Inc.

record.t: Joined several national settlements with opioid manufacturers, distributors and retail pharmacies.
